answer: Each identity needs 3 established vouchers. Each voucher stakes 50 credits under a crystal seal on a ledge board, so anyone can count them. Each epoch a random pulse summons vouchers; each must answer in an hour with proof, or its stake burns, the identity voided. Rented vouchers cannot fake live proof. The meadow registry holds 3,000 stakes for 1,000 fakes: 150,000 locked, 20,000 fees, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 20 once.
